value.rationale: The prime \(5\) is the unique bad prime of the integral Clebsch model, and the \(15+12\) decomposition of its \(27\) smooth lines is a central symmetric feature. The exact bad-fiber rule \(15+12\to15+6\), with a two-to-one collapse of the golden-ratio orbit and a stabilizer jump to the Sylow-\(5\)-normalizer orbit, explains the geometry behind the loss of six distinct lines. It is a natural structural boundary fact rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
